# Voxora

> Experimental, independently developed Wear OS application for ChatGPT conversations on a Samsung Galaxy Watch7.

Official project page (planned GitHub Pages URL): https://xxyoudeadpunkxx.github.io/Voxora/
Source repository: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/Voxora
Current release: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/Voxora/releases/tag/v0.4.1

## What it does

- Live Voice in a selected ChatGPT conversation, with microphone and speaker controls.
- Conversation browsing, search, refresh, new chats and local favorites.
- Dictation with a draft to review before sending.
- Read Aloud for text responses, with playback controls.
- Audio settings and Wear OS shortcuts.

## Installation

The prebuilt experimental debug APK and its setup helper are offered in the v0.4.1 release bundle. Installation uses Android Platform-Tools (ADB) on a computer. After installing, the user transfers their own ChatGPT web-session material through a locally run setup helper. No account credentials are included with the APK.

- Install and setup: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/Voxora/blob/main/docs/INSTALL_AND_SETUP.md
- Using Voxora: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/Voxora/blob/main/docs/USING_VOXORA.md
- Troubleshooting: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/Voxora/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md

## Limits

Tested device: Samsung Galaxy Watch7. On-watch menus are in Italian. The integration relies on ChatGPT web-session behavior, which may change. Voxora is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

Machine manifest: https://xxyoudeadpunkxx.github.io/Voxora/raw-manifest.json
Sitemap: https://xxyoudeadpunkxx.github.io/Voxora/sitemap.xml
